description: Record what one agent run cost an issue (local or mirrored/upstream): tokens by kind and machine time. Re-sending the same 'source' + 'externalId' updates that record instead of adding a second one, so a retry never doubles the spend. Omit a metric you did not measure — omitted is 'not reported', which is different from zero. Requires permission to edit the issue.

agent.description: Which agent did the work, e.g. 'claude-code'.

agentSeconds.description: Wall-clock seconds the run took. Machine time, not a worklog.

costUsd.description: Cost in USD, if you know the rates that applied.

externalId.description: Your own key for this record (usually the run id). Re-sending it updates the record.

model.description: Which model it ran on, e.g. 'claude-opus-5'.

runId.description: The run this record belongs to, when one run reports several records (different models or hosts).

source.description: Who is reporting, e.g. 'bg-agent-api'. Idempotency is scoped to it.

name: report_agent_usage
